survey.titleEn: Complaint Form — Fujairah Open Judo Championships
survey.titleAr: نموذج تقديم شكوى — بطولة الفجيرة المفتوحة للجودو
survey.descriptionEn: Open to any participant, delegation, or visitor to report an issue during the tournament.
survey.descriptionAr: متاح لأي مشارك أو وفد أو زائر للإبلاغ عن مشكلة خلال البطولة.

target.formula: count of complaints received during the tournament window (target: fewer than 5)

questions.labelEn: Your name (optional — leave blank to report anonymously)
questions.labelAr: اسمك (اختياري — اتركه فارغاً للإبلاغ دون ذكر الاسم)

questions.labelEn: Team/delegation, or your role (spectator, official, etc.)

survey.scoringNotes: Reading = raw count of complaint submissions received during the tournament dates. Target: under 5.
